name: FK Ghana
shortDesc: Connecting brands with people. Turning engagement into growth.
paragraphs: First Katalyst Marketing (FKM) Ghana helps businesses connect with their audiences through creative marketing, memorable experiences and effective execution. Based in Accra, we combine local market understanding with practical strategies to build brand visibility, strengthen customer relationships and support business growth.

services.title: Experiential Marketing & Brand Activations
services.desc: Engaging experiences that bring brands closer to consumers.

services.title: Corporate Events & Conferences
services.desc: Planning and managing corporate events, sales and marketing conferences, product launches, dealer meetings and business gatherings.

services.title: Field Marketing & Trade Promotions
services.desc: On-ground campaigns that support product awareness, distribution and sales.

services.title: Digital Marketing & Engagement
services.desc: Campaigns that connect brands with audiences across digital channels.

services.title: Market Research & Consumer Insights
services.desc: Research and reporting that inform marketing decisions and track performance.

closing: From concept development and planning to logistics, execution and reporting, we work as an extension of our clients' teams, bringing creativity, accountability and attention to detail to every project.

contact.address: 49, George Bush Highway, Dzorwulu, Accra, Ghana

name: Image Target
shortDesc: Putting brands in view. Making lasting impressions.
paragraphs: Image Target is an outdoor advertising company that helps businesses build visibility and connect with audiences where they live, work and travel. Based in Lagos, we help brands communicate through strategically placed out-of-home advertising.

services.title: Billboard Advertising
services.desc: Outdoor displays that strengthen brand awareness and keep businesses in public view.

services.title: Outdoor Campaign Planning
services.desc: Location and format selection to reach relevant audiences and support campaign objectives.

services.title: Branding & Signage
services.desc: Branded signs and displays that give businesses a distinctive, visible presence.

services.title: Campaign Production & Installation
services.desc: Coordinating production and installation to bring outdoor campaigns to life.

services.title: Campaign Monitoring & Maintenance
services.desc: Supporting the visibility, presentation and upkeep of advertising displays throughout a campaign.

closing: From campaign planning to execution, we focus on clear messaging, strong visual impact and reliable delivery to help brands make lasting impressions.

contact.address: 1A Community Lane, Near Galaxy TV, Off Allen Avenue, Ikeja, Lagos, Nigeria

name: FK Properties
shortDesc: Connecting you with the right property in Lagos.
paragraphs: FK Properties helps individuals and businesses find properties that suit their needs, preferences and investment goals. With properties across Lagos, including Ikeja GRA, Adeniyi Jones and other locations, we offer options for residential and commercial use.
Whether you are looking for a home, business premises or a property investment, we provide guidance to help you explore available options and make informed decisions.

services.title: Residential Properties
services.desc: Homes and apartments across Lagos for individuals and families.

services.title: Commercial Properties
services.desc: Spaces suited to offices, retail outlets and other business needs.

services.title: Property Sales & Lettings
services.desc: Support with finding properties to buy, rent or lease.

services.title: Property Investment Opportunities
services.desc: Options for buyers seeking long-term value in the Lagos property market.

closing: We focus on understanding your requirements, communicating clearly and helping you find a property that fits your plans.

contact.locations: Ikeja GRA, Adeniyi Jones and other areas across Lagos, Nigeria
